Yagiz Kaan Erdogmus is showing some amazing chess recently. In the 3rd round of the European Club Cup 2026, he was up against the experienced Czech GM Hracek Zbynek. Check out the game and especially the time trouble phase. It was quite intense and shows how good Yagiz really is.
